entry: E65 reserved Three fox pictures and six owl pictures, separate groups.
note: Invented for practice; independent check only. Nine, both groups. Meets: nine dots, "Nine." Shape: Whole across separate animal groups without intermediate totals; practice corrects supplied classroom-object totals on already-combined mats, never separated animal groups/blank total panels.

entry: E66 reserved One boot picture and seven scattered boot pictures, no route.
note: Invented for practice; independent check only. Eight, each picture once. Meets: eight matched ticks and count eight. Shape: Independently devise a route across scattered groups; practice follows adult-supplied routes and repairs a supplied missing tick, never invents a route or uses boots.

entry: E67 reserved Two quiet chime sounds, pause, then six; repeat identically if needed.
note: Invented for practice; independent check only. Eight units, both bursts. Meets: two disks joined by six, eight dots. Shape: Reconstruct heard bursts independently as action/paper trace; practice moves visible squares jointly or corrects supplied clap records, never reconstructs heard bursts. Quiet mouth sounds/visible beats or tactile taps replace a chime.

entry: E68 reserved Ten large paper bean pictures in a pile.
note: Invented for practice; independent check only. Ten first, three moved, seven remain. Meets: seven ringed, three outside. Shape: Independently remove a specified part from a fresh loose whole; practice corrects already-moved square layouts or follows directed partitions, never independent new-pile removal. Paper beans replace real beans.

entry: E69 reserved Silent toy-boat panels show five in play and Rin bringing two more.
note: Invented for practice; independent check only. Five first, two join, seven now. Meets: "Rin had five boats, brought two, seven now." Shape: Independently narrate/enact a silent joining scene with a partner; practice supplies a missing action in adult-started square stories, never creates complete stories from silent panels or uses boats.

Invented for practice; independent check only. Six first, two joining, whole-question, in order. Meets: "Six puppets, two more, how many now?" Eight is a later solution, not a second exit ask. Shape: Retell a complete unseen heard story before solving; practice predicts missing events with adult cues or finishes partial retellings, never retells an entire unseen story or uses puppets.

Invented for practice; independent check only. Nine first, six inside, three outside. Meets: three traced outside, faithful retelling. Shape: Independent retelling coordinated with object/location action; practice follows adult narration event by event or repairs partial cues, never independently retells while moving or uses trucks.

Invented for practice; independent check only. Ten represented, three removed, seven remaining. Meets: ten dots, three crossed, seven ringed. Shape: Generate a complete separating drawing independently on blank paper; practice uses adult-directed counters or supplied partial drawing corrections, never a whole blank-paper solution or puzzle pieces.

Invented for practice; independent check only. Seven first, one joins, eight; parts tied to question. Meets: seven outlined, one added, "All eight shells." Invented for practice; independent check only. First picture: six first, two off, four remain. Meets: six-start/two-off positively marked. Selection alone does not establish method.

Invented for practice; independent check only. Ten initial marks, six changed, four remain. Meets: ten dots, six crossed, four ringed. Invented for practice; independent check only. Both change by seven; join to ten, remove to three. Meets: "Seven come in here, seven go out there." Results support comparison, not extra asks. entry: E77 reserved Two closed-box pictures and eight open-box pictures.
note: Invented for practice; independent check only. Both groups, total-unknown question, ten if solved. Meets: "Rin has two closed boxes and eight open boxes. How many boxes altogether?" Shape: Create a whole total-unknown story from pictures; practice completes an adult-started object-story question, never creates a whole picture-prompt story or uses boxes. Unheard stories stay pending.

entry: E78 reserved Read card 2 + 5. Badge scenes: Rin brings five to two; takes five from seven; leaves two and keeps five unused.
note: Invented for practice; independent check only. Two first, five join, seven now. Meets: first scene and incoming group marked. Shape: Expression-to-action recognition with positive action evidence; practice builds/corrects an adult-started action then writes a sign, never selects finished actions from expressions or uses badges.

Invented for practice; independent check only. Nine total, seven/two parts, accepts total-left. Meets: correct mat, both groups marked. Shape: Spoken total-left equation to existing objects, all choices same total so counting/elimination alone is insufficient; practice jointly builds/corrects quantities beside equations, never selects complete object mats, seven/two partitions or fans.

entry: E80 reserved Bare card 10 - 2, blank paper and loose counters. Read

entry: E81 reserved Six cup pictures with empty arriving-group box.
